Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars, prune trees to encourage air circulation.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicides containing captan or myclobutanil early in the growing season.

Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Prune out dead or diseased branches and remove mummified fruit from trees.
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Apply captan or copper-based fungicides starting at silver tip through petal fall.
Apple___Black_rot.citation: Penn State Extension - Apple Disease Management

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Remove nearby eastern red cedar trees if possible; plant resistant varieties.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Apply immunox or sulfur-based fungicides from pink bud through petal fall.

Apple___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering and fertilization schedules.
Apple___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Maintain acidic soil pH (4.5–5.5) and adequate soil moisture.
Blueberry___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Prune trees to improve light penetration and airflow.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate fungicides at first sign of white fungal growth.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.citation: UC IPM Cherry Powdery Mildew Guidelines

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Provide balanced irrigation and proper canopy pruning.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Practice crop rotation with non-host crops and till crop residue.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Apply foliar fungicides such as azoxystrobin or pyraclostrobin when disease pressure is high.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids and manage field residue.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Apply fungicides if rust pustules cover significant leaf area before tasseling.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Utilize resistant hybrids and practice 2-year crop rotation.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Spray triazole or strobilurin-based fungicides early in disease outbreak.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Ensure optimal nitrogen fertilization and weed management.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Ensure good sunlight exposure and canopy airflow by pruning.
Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Apply myclobutanil or mancozeb fungicides from pre-bloom through post-bloom.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Protect pruning wounds with wound sealants to prevent spore entry.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Remove infected wood and apply systemic fungicides during dormant pruning.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Rake and destroy fallen leaves in autumn.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Apply copper-based sprays or Mancozeb after fruit set.

Grape___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).cause: Bacterium (Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus) spread by Asian citrus psyllid
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Control Asian citrus psyllid populations with insecticides and use certified disease-free trees.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: No cure exists; remove infected trees immediately to prevent insect-borne spread.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant resistant varieties and avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper sprays during leaf fall and oxytetracycline during early blooming.

Peach___healthy.prevention: Monitor for tree borers and maintain balanced soil nutrition.
Peach___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use pathogen-free seeds, avoid overhead irrigation, and rotate crops.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray fixed copper mixed with mancozeb to manage bacterial populations.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Ensure consistent soil moisture and adequate calcium supply.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops and maintain adequate plant nutrition (especially nitrogen).
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb at initial symptom appearance.

Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified seed tubers and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply systemic fungicides such as cymoxanil or copper hydroxide immediately.

Potato___healthy.prevention: Hill soil properly and manage field drainage.
Potato___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure well-drained soil and prune old canes after harvest.
Raspberry___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Soybean___healthy.prevention: Practice annual crop rotation with corn or small grains.
Soybean___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant in full sun and select resistant squash varieties.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply neem oil, sulfur sprays, or potassium bicarbonate at first sign of white spots.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Remove dead foliage after harvest and practice drip irrigation.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides or captan before flowering.

Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Straw mulch beds to prevent soil contact with leaves.
Strawberry___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Sanitize tools, use certified disease-free seed, and avoid wet foliage.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper fungicide combined with actigard or mancozeb.

Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Stake tomatoes to elevate foliage off soil and practice crop rotation.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or copper sprays every 7–10 days.

Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead watering and destroy infected plants promptly.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply copper-based or chlorothalonil fungicides immediately upon detection.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Keep relative humidity in greenhouse/garden below 85% with ventilation.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Apply copper fungicides or chlorothalonil starting at early infection.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Mulch around plant bases to prevent fungal spores from splashing up from soil.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply copper fungicides or chlorothalonil at first sign of lower leaf spots.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Avoid dusty conditions and protect natural predatory insects.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Spray with insecticidal soap, neem oil, or specific miticides.

Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Improve field drainage and maintain adequate canopy airflow.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use yellow sticky traps and insect mesh screens to control whitefly vector.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: Remove virus-infected plants; apply imidacloprid or insecticidal soap for whitefly control.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.citation: UC IPM Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.cause: Tobamovirus (ToMV) spread mechanically via hands and tools
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Wash hands with soap/milk before handling plants; disinfect tools with bleach.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No chemical cure exists; pull out and discard infected plants.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering at the root level and balanced nutrition.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The plant is healthy.
